title: No type validation for ts timestamp in RollcallResource
description: Line 153 uses data.get('ts', int(time.time())) without validating that ts is a numeric type. An attacker could POST {"id": "x", "ts": "malicious"} and the string would be stored as 'started'. Contrast with SosResource (lines 92-97) which properly validates timestamps are finite positive numbers. Add type and range validation before storing.
